admission.justification: Together Rules 1-5 close the full PR-landed standalone master end path (eligibility, finalize readiness, pre-Completed cleanup admission, abandoned-contract recording guard, and Manager procedure); no single rule alone guarantees both end-to-end completion without manual status edits and that abandoned contracts cannot re-enter through record_landing.

guarantee: A pull-request-landed standalone master ends through the ordered worktree_record_landing, lifecycle_finalize_task, and retire_master sequence without prior closeout or manual status edits, while cleanup stays before task-document completion and abandoned, sprint-commanded, checkpointed, or leaf contracts cannot enter that end path.
title: PR-landed standalone masters end cleanly while abandoned contracts stay closed
